paper_evidence: Section IV-A, printed p. 72862, describes seven HAM diagnoses plus a two-class malignant/benign dataset; Section IV-D, printed p. 72864, discusses all nine output labels.
project_evidence: Research completion plan lists AKIEC, BCC, BKL, DF, MEL, NV, VASC, BENIGN, MALIGNANT; Stage 4 defines the same labels.
finding: The broad nine-output construction is supported; paper output indices and exact class encoding are not stated.

claim_or_question: Seven HAM10000 diagnoses are retained as separate outputs
paper_evidence: Section IV-A, printed p. 72862; Section IV-D, printed p. 72864.
project_evidence: Stage 4 uppercases and retains the original HAM dx field, lines 74-80.
finding: No HAM diagnosis is mapped into BENIGN or MALIGNANT by the inspected local mapping code.

claim_or_question: The added outputs are BENIGN and MALIGNANT
paper_evidence: Section IV-A, printed p. 72862, describes the second dataset as two-class benign/malignant; Section IV-D, printed p. 72864, discusses both outputs.
project_evidence: Stage 4 maps local folder labels benign/malignant directly to the respective outputs, lines 83-90.
finding: This verifies source-conditioned output names, not mutually exclusive universal clinical diagnoses.

claim_or_question: The paper's binary source is ISIC 2017
paper_evidence: The searchable text in Section IV-A, printed p. 72862, cites references [45] and [54] for a generic two-class dataset; Table 2 body on p. 72863 is non-text content in this audit.
project_evidence: The existing paper_table2_transcription.csv says ISIC 2017; project plan calls out source-name conflict.
finding: The source name is present in an existing transcription but not independently verified from primary Table 2 cells.

claim_or_question: The 3,297-image binary subset is the official ISIC 2017 Task 3 release with its official labels
paper_evidence: Official ISIC Task 3 page describes two independent binary tasks over three diagnoses and 2,000 training images; official data page lists 2,000 train, 150 validation, 600 test.
project_evidence: Table 2 transcription records 3,297 binary rows labeled only BENIGN/MALIGNANT; local source is unverified-version Fanconic.
finding: As an identity claim to the complete official Task 3 release and its official labels, the total and label schema do not match. This does not identify what EG-VAN actually used.

claim_or_question: Exact Table 2 class counts and source column
paper_evidence: Table 2 title appears on printed p. 72863; its body cells are not available in the searchable text layer.
project_evidence: paper_table2_transcription.csv records counts and an ISIC 2017 source column; completion plan says the augmented total does not reconcile with text totals.
finding: The project transcription is secondary evidence only; counts and source-column cells have not been independently checked against the primary table.

claim_or_question: Per-image label mapping and source version are reproducible
paper_evidence: Paper Section IV-A, printed p. 72862, gives aggregate source descriptions and citations, but no direct package/version or per-image manifest.
project_evidence: Suitability decision reports no local package receipt, label provenance, source-ID map, or verified source version; Stage 4 calls the source unverified.
finding: Aggregate class counts and matching folder names do not establish image identity, exact version, or original labels.

claim_or_question: BENIGN and MALIGNANT are mutually exclusive with the seven HAM diagnoses
paper_evidence: Paper combines the outputs as nine classes but provides no source-conditioned semantic rule resolving overlap between broad binary labels and specific diagnoses.
project_evidence: Project recovery decision explicitly keeps source labels distinct and warns against relabeling HAM diagnoses as BENIGN/MALIGNANT.
finding: No medical equivalence or priority rule is inferred. A source label can be a separate model output without being a mutually exclusive clinical diagnosis.

claim_or_question: Paper split and validation construction are fully reproducible
paper_evidence: Section IV-C, printed p. 72863, reports a 1,332-image original test set and enlarged training/validation totals, but no seed or image-level membership.
project_evidence: Project completion plan reports no author split manifest, source-ID map, or augmentation lineage; Stage 4 final split remains false/blocked.
finding: Aggregate counts and broad procedure are reported, but image membership, grouping, and reproducible split construction are absent from available evidence.

claim_or_question: Paper describes cross-source duplicate or patient/lesion overlap handling
paper_evidence: No duplicate, overlap, patient-ID, lesion-ID, or random-seed disclosure was located in the searchable paper text; Sections IV-A and IV-C give no such rule.
project_evidence: Project recovery and completion documents report substantial overlap concerns and absent binary patient/lesion IDs; no approved split exists.
finding: Absence from searchable text does not prove no author-side analysis existed; no paper rule can be reproduced from available evidence.

claim_or_question: Project final nine-class dataset/split is approved
paper_evidence: Not applicable to paper method evidence.
project_evidence: Stage 4 split_eligibility_audit.json says final_split_created=false and split gate blocked; validation report records the current inventory state.
finding: R1 does not approve data, a cohort, a split, or training.
